coordinates.locator: Table 1, "Locations of Black Rock Hills Site and HiRes 1&2 sites"
coordinates.note: Row "HR1" of the HiRes collaboration's table of site positions (longitude, latitude, elevation); longitude is printed as -112.8358 W, i.e. 112.8358 degrees west. Four decimals; 100 m is a conservative allowance for how the position was taken. The paper is a conference proceeding by the HiRes and Telescope Array collaborations that describes the detector sites, filed as detector_paper.

summary.plain: The first station of the High Resolution Fly's Eye cosmic-ray fluorescence detector, on a hilltop in the Utah desert, on the U.S. Army Dugway Proving Ground.
summary.technical: HiRes-I fluorescence station (22 telescope modules) at 40.1952 N, 112.8358 W, 1596 m, on a hilltop about 130 m above the desert floor on the Dugway Proving Ground, Utah; 12.6 km from HiRes-II.
